eyebrow: SOQL & Salesforce Data Management · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 7 · SOQL Aggregation & Grouping

code:
SELECT COUNT(Id) total,
       SUM(Amount) totalAmount,
       AVG(Amount) avgAmount,
       MIN(Amount) smallest,
       MAX(Amount) largest
FROM Opportunity
WHERE StageName = 'Closed Won'
caption: One row summarizing every closed-won opportunity.

code:
-- Rows matched; must be alone in SELECT
SELECT COUNT() FROM Account

-- Non-null values; can mix with aggregates
SELECT COUNT(Industry) FROM Account

-- Unique non-null values
SELECT COUNT_DISTINCT(AccountId)
FROM Opportunity
caption: COUNT() versus COUNT(field), just like COUNT(*) in T-SQL.

code:
SELECT SUM(Amount) totalAmount
FROM Opportunity

-- Alias goes directly after: no AS
-- No alias? Columns are named

-- Apex: ar.get('totalAmount')
caption: Aggregate queries return AggregateResult records.
